instruction: Change the title text 'SLIDE TITLE' on the second slide of the open presentation to 'CAMPUS VIEW' and save the file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to slide 2, selected the background image, increased brightness to 50% using the Properties panel, saved the image as background.png to Desktop via right-click > Save. However, the evaluator expected GIMP-level brightness enhancement, not LibreOffice display property change. Score was -0.2 (task error).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate between slides, select images, modify image properties (brightness/contrast) via Properties panel, right-click and save images, navigate file system dialogs, type text values in fields
metadata.failure_analysis: Original task required multi-app workflow (Impress -> GIMP -> save). Model tried to do everything within LibreOffice Impress. The brightness adjustment in Impress only modifies display properties, not actual pixel data. The exported image didn't meet the evaluator's brightness quality criteria.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single-app text editing task within LibreOffice Impress. The model demonstrated ability to navigate to slide 2 and interact with slide elements. Changing title text is a simpler, verifiable task within demonstrated capability.
metadata.explanation: Getter reads the PPTX file from VM, navigates to slide 2 (index 1), finds the shape named 'Rectangle 15' which contains the title text, and returns its text content. Metric compares the returned text against the expected 'CAMPUS VIEW' with case-insensitive matching.

scoring_breakdown.partial_match: 0.5 - Title text partially contains expected text

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slide index 1 (second slide, 0-indexed) matching the instruction's 'second slide' requirement
Getter extracts text from shape 'Rectangle 15' which is identified as the title shape in this specific PPTX template
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_text') without wrapping in 'rules'
Case-insensitive comparison (both uppercased) is appropriate for text content verification
Postconfig ensures file is saved (Ctrl+S + Enter for overwrite confirmation) before getter reads from disk, addressing the 'save the file' requirement
Both instruction requirements are covered: (1) text change verified by getter+metric, (2) file save ensured by postconfig and verified implicitly by reading from file
Partial credit scoring (0.5 for substring match) is reasonable for this task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Shape name 'Rectangle 15' is an unusual name for a title shape (typically named 'Title 1' or similar). Verify this matches the actual shape name in the PPT-Template_widescreen.pptx template to avoid false negatives.
